changelog: In-Memory Threat Defense: auto-remediere & restituire activa a octetilor AMSI/ETW (AmsiScanBuffer, EtwEventWrite)
Unbacked Reflective PE Scanner: detectie in memorie privata unbacked a modulelor PE injectate (Process Hollowing / Cobalt Strike)
Fleet Containment: Emergency Lockdown prin Windows Filtering Platform (izolare host instantanee la nivel de kernel)
SecOps Dashboard: actiuni directe de Host Isolation, One-Click Rollback si Scanare Profunda de Memorie
